Class ConfirmDialog

java.lang.Object
com.trevorschoeny.menukit.core.dialog.ConfirmDialog
public final class ConfirmDialog extends Object
Builder for a modal confirm/cancel dialog. Composes a Panel from existing primitives (TextLabel, Button, M8 layout helpers) and ships it with modal flags pre-configured (opaque + dimsBehind + tracksAsModal).

The returned Panel is added to the consumer's UI like any other panel. Visibility is consumer-managed via Panel.showWhen(BooleanSupplier) per Principle 8 ("elements are lenses, not stores"). Confirm and Cancel callbacks fire on the corresponding buttons; consumers mutate their own state to dismiss.

Canonical usage

private boolean confirmDeleteOpen = false;

Panel deleteDialog = ConfirmDialog.builder()
    .title(Component.literal("Delete sandbox?"))
    .body(Component.literal("This cannot be undone."))
    .onConfirm(() -> { confirmDeleteOpen = false; deleteSandbox(); })
    .onCancel(() -> confirmDeleteOpen = false)
    .build()
    .showWhen(() -> confirmDeleteOpen);

// Register the dialog with the host screen via ScreenPanelAdapter.
new ScreenPanelAdapter(deleteDialog, MenuRegion.CENTER)
    .on(MyMenuScreen.class);

// Trigger from another button:
deleteButton.onClick(() -> confirmDeleteOpen = true);

Cross-context applicability

Dialogs work in MenuContext (vanilla container screen decoration), StandaloneContext (decorating vanilla standalone screens via mixin), and on MenuKit-native MKScreen subclasses: add the modal() dialog Panel to the screen's panel list (visibility driven by Panel.showWhen(BooleanSupplier)) and MKScreen's modal-aware path handles it — dimsBehind panels are auto-centered, the dim layer + click-eat + key dispatch route input to the dialog's buttons only. SlotGroupContext and HudContext don't apply (anchor mismatch / no input dispatch).

Multi-line body

Body is a single Component in v1. For multi-line dialog bodies, compose the Panel manually using the same M8 patterns this builder uses internally (see DIALOGS.md §5 escape-hatch example). A multi-line TextLabel variant is filed as a deferred primitive (see DEFERRED.md).
